{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Racial and religious profiling is wrong and we will work to stamp it out.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Hate crimes desecrate sacred spaces and demean good people.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"We support a strong national law to punish hate crimes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Today's immigration laws do not reflect our values or serve our security, and we will work for real reform.",
"claim_types":["evaluation","policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Establishing a massive new status of second-class workers betrays our values and hurts all working people.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Undocumented immigrants within our borders who clear a background check, work hard and pay taxes should have a path to earn full participation in America.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We will hasten family reunification for parents and children, husbands and wives.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We will offer more English-language and civic education classes so immigrants can assume all the rights and responsibilities of citizenship.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"As we undertake these steps, we will work with our neighbors to strengthen our security so we are safer from those who would come here to harm us.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"We are a nation of immigrants, and from Arab-Americans in California to Latinos in Florida, we share the dream of a better life in the country we love.",
"claim_types":["characterization"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
